Existing representative Titan sample does not establish complete real Titan domain
Existing Scorpion adapter still uses representative spell pool
Existing Ox adapter still uses representative eight-cost pool
Existing Murloc adapter still uses representative transform pool

collection_policy: All new treasure faces remain noncollectible; no new Standard deck roots
known_local_policies: Equal shared-tier weights inferred locally, not verified by raw tag or official count statements
Discover fixed printed Cost uses current-class and neutral collectible cards from the full installed ordinary domain
Living Stone deathrattle uses any-class collectible printed two-Cost minion from the full ordinary domain
Glyph captures the selected minion and original immediate physical board neighbors when its body starts; frozen references preserve identity
Heartblossom resolves its captured friendly buff, then re-reads living enemy minions for random damage
